item.title: Former Chairman Noh Tae-ak, 'Coming to work once every two days' ahead of elections, received 179.1 million won in allowances over four years (선거 앞두고 ‘이틀에 한 번 출근’ 노태악 전 위원장, 4년간 수당만 1억7910만원)
item.description:
Former Chairman Noh Tae-ak, 'Coming to work once every two days' ahead of elections, received 179.1 million won in allowances over four years (선거 앞두고 ‘이틀에 한 번 출근’ 노태악 전 위원장, 4년간 수당만 1억7910만원)

Former Central Election Commission Chairman Noh Tae-ak, who resigned taking responsibility for the shortage of ballots in the June 3 local elections, has been found to have received 179.1 million won in allowances while working part-time over four years. Regardless of whether he commuted to work, former Chairman Noh received a minimum of 550,000 won to a maximum of 6.15 million won per month. (6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태의 책임을 지고 사퇴한 노태악 전 중앙선거관리위원장이 4년간 비상근으로 일하며 수당 1억7910만원을 받은 것으로 나타났다. 노 전 위원장은 출퇴근 여부와 무관하게 월 최소 55만원에서 최대 615만원을 받았다.)

According to data submitted by the National Election Commission on the 19th to the office of People Power Party lawmaker Kim Min-jeon, former Chairman Noh received a total of 179,103,220 won in various allowances from his appointment in May 2022 up to last month. (19일 중앙선거관리위원회가 국민의힘 김민전 의원실에 제출한 자료에 따르면 노 전 위원장은 2022년 5월 취임한 이후 지난달까지 각종 수당 명목으로 1억7910만3220원을 받았다.)

Broken down by allowance type, he received 97.1 million won in fair election promotion activity expenses, 66.3 million won in agenda review allowances, and 15.7 million won in attendance allowances. The NEC paid former Chairman Noh 2.9 million won per month in fair election promotion activity expenses regardless of his attendance, provided 150,000 won per meeting for attendance at official events including meetings, and paid 100,000 won per agenda item for agenda review allowances during meetings. (수당 항목별로 보면 공명선거추진활동비 9710만원, 안건검토수당 6630만원, 출무수당 1570만원이다. 중앙선관위는 노 전 위원장의 출근 여부와 무관하게 공명선거추진활동비로 매달 290만원씩 지급했고 회의를 포함한 공식 행사 참석의 경우 회당 15만원의 출무수당을, 회의의 경우 안건 1개당 10만원씩 안건검토수당을 지급했다.)

Notably, after the Board of Audit and Inspection pointed out issues with the 2.9 million won monthly fair election promotion activity expenses paid to former Chairman Noh, the NEC employed a tactic of reorganizing the existing allowance system to continue providing the chairman's allowances. (특히 중앙선관위는 노 전 위원장에게 지급하던 매달 290만원의 공명선거추진활동비가 감사원 감사에서 지적을 받자 기존 수당 체계를 개편하는 꼼수로 위원장의 수당을 챙겨주기도 했다.)

In 2022, when former Chairman Noh took office, the NEC paid him 2.9 million won each month under the name of fair election promotion activity expenses without a legal basis. When the BAI pointed out in November of that year that these allowances "lacked a legal basis," the NEC stopped the payments in January 2023. Instead, the NEC amended its 'Regulations on Allowances for NEC Commissioners' through its own resolution, raising the agenda review allowance from the existing 100,000 won to 300,000 won. Consequently, former Chairman Noh received 5.1 million won in June 2023 solely from agenda review allowances. (중앙선관위는 노 전 위원장이 취임하던 2022년에 법적 근거 없이 공명선거추진활동비라는 명목으로 노 전 위원장에게 매달 290만원씩 지급했다. 그해 11월 감사원이 해당 수당에 “법적 근거가 없다”고 지적하자 중앙선관위는 2023년 1월 지급을 중단했다. 대신 중앙선관위 자체 의결로 ‘중앙선관위 위원 수당에 관한 규칙’을 개정해 안건검토수당을 기존 10만원에서 30만원으로 올렸다. 이에 따라 노 전 위원장은 2023년 6월 안건검토수당으로만 510만원을 받기도 했다.)

Later, in January 2024, the National Assembly revised the Election Commission Act to create a legal basis for the fair election promotion activity expenses that the BAI had flagged, and from January 2024 onward, former Chairman Noh again received 2.9 million won per month. From that point, the agenda review allowance was restored from 300,000 won back to the original 100,000 won. (이후 국회가 2024년 1월 선관위법을 개정해 감사원이 지적한 공명선거추진활동비의 법적 근거를 만들었고 노 전 위원장은 다시 2024년 1월부터 매달 290만원씩 받았다. 안건검토수당은 이때부터 다시 30만원에서 기존 10만원으로 원상회복됐다.)

Earlier, former Chairman Noh's attendance record had also been called into question. He received allowances of 4.1 million won in March, 5.15 million won in April, and 4.15 million won in June—months just before the election. It has been reported that former Chairman Noh worked a total of 6 days in March, 12 days in April, and 16 days in May. (앞서 노 전 위원장의 근태가 지적되기도 했다. 노 전 위원장은 선거 직전인 지난 3월 410만원, 4월 515만원, 6월 415만원의 수당을 받았다. 노 전 위원장이 출근한 날짜는 3월 총 6일, 4월 총 12일, 5월 총 16일인 것으로 알려졌다.)

Meanwhile, the NEC's fact-finding committee announced after a meeting that day that it has recommended requesting an investigation by the NEC into 12 individuals, including former NEC Chairman Noh and acting NEC Chairman Wi Cheol-hwan. (한편 중앙선관위 진상규명위원회는 이날 회의 뒤 노 전 중앙선거관리위원장과 위철환 중앙선관위원장 직무대행 등 12명에 대해 중앙선관위에 수사 의뢰를 권고했다고 밝혔다.)

item.title: "Board of Audit and Inspection Should Inspect the National Election Commission... Open Discussion Needed on Whether to Keep Advance Voting" (“감사원, 선관위 감찰해야… 사전투표 존폐는 공론화를”)
item.description:
"Board of Audit and Inspection Should Inspect the National Election Commission... Open Discussion Needed on Whether to Keep Advance Voting" (“감사원, 선관위 감찰해야… 사전투표 존폐는 공론화를”)

The Central Election Commission's Fact-Finding Committee, which investigated the shortage of ballots during the June 3 local elections, concluded on the 19th—after nine days of inquiry—that the incident was a "total failure of the election management system." The committee recommended that the NEC refer 12 individuals, including former NEC Chair Noh Tae-ak and Acting Chair Wi Cheol-hwan (a standing commissioner), for investigation. The decision on whether to pursue an investigation is expected to be discussed at a plenary meeting of the NEC next week. The committee also proposed that the NEC undergo a duty inspection by the Board of Audit and Inspection and that the NEC chairmanship, traditionally held part-time by a Supreme Court justice, be converted to a full-time position. Regarding the advance voting system, which has faced neglect from some voters, the committee called for a public forum to debate its continuation or abolition. <<> Fact-Finding Committee Chair Jo Hyeon-uk stated at a briefing that, along with former Chair Noh Tae-ak and former Secretary-General Heo Cheol-hun, who have already stepped down over the ballot shortage, Acting Chair Wi Cheol-hwan, a standing commissioner, should also be referred for investigation. Acting Chair Wi, a classmate of President Lee Jae-myung from the 18th class of the Judicial Research and Training Institute, has served as a standing commissioner since last October. The standing commissioner is the only full-time position among the nine NEC commissioners, tasked with assisting the chair and overseeing the secretariat's affairs. However, the seven non-standing NEC commissioners, excluding former Chair Noh and Acting Chair Wi, were not included in the recommendation for investigation. <<> The fact-finding committee also included Seoul Central District Court Chief Judge Oh Min-seok, who served as chair of the Seoul Metropolitan Election Commission, and Min So-young, Senior Presiding Judge of the Seoul Eastern District Court, who chaired the Songpa-gu Election Commission, in its recommendations for referral and disciplinary action. An NEC official stated that regarding the committee's recommendations for investigation and disciplinary measures, "If reported to the plenary meeting scheduled for next week, the commissioners will discuss them." <<> Ahead of this local election, the NEC sent guidelines to local election commissions last December, reducing the minimum print run of ballots from 60% of eligible voters to 50%. At least 91 polling stations experienced ballot shortages, and 26 stations ran out of ballots entirely, halting voting. The fact-finding committee described this as "undermining the people's constitutional right to vote through an extremely administrative convenience-oriented mindset" and recommended raising the minimum print run to 70%. Former Chair Noh Tae-ak reportedly told the committee that he had not been briefed on the "50% guideline" beforehand, but later changed his stance, stating that it "was included in the agenda but not specifically discussed, and I did not receive any in-person briefing on the details." <<> Regarding the chaos at polling stations and election commissions, the fact-finding committee noted that "the rapid reporting system completely failed to function, and the higher-level election commissions' command authority was never exercised." The Seoul Metropolitan Election Commission received inquiries from the Songpa-gu Election Commission on election day, June 3, but only realized the severity at 4:46 p.m. and failed to report it to the NEC. Even when voting hours were extended until 10 p.m. at some polling stations in Songpa-gu, Seoul, no report was made to the NEC. Additionally, the Songpa-gu Election Commission began vote counting while voting was still ongoing at the second polling station in Jamsil 7-dong. <<> To prevent a recurrence of election management failures, the fact-finding committee argued that the NEC should be included within the scope of the Board of Audit and Inspection's duty inspections. The NEC has previously avoided such inspections by claiming its status as a "constitutional institution." When the Board of Audit and Inspection attempted to conduct a duty inspection during the Yoon Suk Yeol administration, the NEC filed a jurisdictional dispute with the Constitutional Court, which ruled in the NEC's favor on the 2nd of last year. Some within the ruling party argue that a constitutional amendment is needed to enable such inspections. <<> The fact-finding committee called for amending the Election Commission Act to make the NEC chair a full-time position. Currently, the NEC chair is elected by the commissioners from among themselves, with a Supreme Court justice serving part-time in the role. The committee stated that "most policy decisions are approved by the secretary-general and others, with only post-hoc reports being made" and argued that "the scope of committee resolutions should be expanded." <<> The fact-finding committee recommended holding a public forum to discuss whether to maintain or abolish the advance voting system. The People Power Party has proposed a bill to eliminate advance voting and extend regular voting to two days, while the Democratic Party of Korea has stated that it has yet to discuss the matter. However, the committee did not offer an opinion on calls for a re-election. Fact-Finding Committee Chair Jo Hyeon-uk said, "It is reasonable to defer to the court's judgment." <<> Meanwhile, it was confirmed that former Chair Noh Tae-ak received a total of 179.1 million won in allowances during his four-year part-time tenure. According to data submitted by the NEC to the office of People Power Party lawmaker Kim Min-jeon, the NEC paid former Chair Noh 179.1 million won in various allowances from his appointment in May 2022 through last month. This included a monthly public election promotion allowance of 2.9 million won, paid regardless of attendance, a 150,000 won meeting attendance fee for attending meetings or official events, and a 100,000 won agenda review fee per agenda item. (6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태를 조사해 온 중앙선거관리위원회 진상규명위원회는 19일 9일간의 조사를 마치고 이번 사태를 “선거관리 시스템의 총체적 부실”로 결론 내렸다. 진상규명위는 선관위에 노태악 전 중앙선거관리위원장, 위철환 중앙선관위원장 직무대행(상임위원) 등 12명을 수사 의뢰하라고 권고했다. 수사 의뢰 여부는 다음 주 중앙선관위원 전체 회의에서 논의될 전망이다. 진상규명위는 또 선관위가 감사원의 직무 감찰을 받게 하고, 대법관이 비상근으로 맡아온 중앙선관위원장을 상근제로 바꾸자고 했다. 일부 유권자에게 외면받고 있는 사전투표 제도에 대해선 존폐를 논의할 공론의 장이 필요하다고 했다.)

item.title: Lee: "Even a one-point constitutional amendment on the election commission is necessary... If needed, the president can propose it." (李 “선관위 원포인트 개헌이라도 해야… 필요하면 대통령이 발의”)
item.description:
Lee: "Even a one-point constitutional amendment on the election commission is necessary... If needed, the president can propose it." (李 “선관위 원포인트 개헌이라도 해야… 필요하면 대통령이 발의”)

President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 19th regarding the "ballot paper shortage crisis" in the June 3 local elections, "If there is bipartisan agreement, shouldn't we consider even a one-point constitutional amendment concerning the election commission?" (이재명 대통령은 19일 6·3 지방선거 ‘투표 용지 부족 사태’에 대해 “여야 간에 의견 일치가 된다면 선관위에 관한 원포인트 개헌이라도 해야 하지 않을까”라고 밝혔다.)

In a briefing at the Blue House that day, President Lee criticized the election commission, saying, "How can it be acceptable for the Chief Justice to effectively appoint the chairperson of the election commission like that? And there are reports that due to the commission being part-time, they didn't even properly show up on election day—how is that acceptable?" He added, "Shouldn't there be proper monitoring, checks, and controls? I believe there is a need to overhaul the legal framework for this." He further stated, "If necessary, the president can directly propose legislation." The implication is that since the election commission is an independent agency under the constitution, strengthening checks, controls, and oversight over it can only be achieved through constitutional amendment. The Democratic Party is making the same argument. However, the People Power Party maintains that constitutional reform is a matter for later, and currently, a parliamentary investigation and a special counsel probe are necessary. <<> In response, President Lee commented, "We need to observe whether the political circles are seriously trying to resolve this issue or using it as a tool for political attacks. We will decide on the government's position after reviewing the political discussions." <<> President Lee also pointed out the ballot paper shortage, saying, "When making ballot papers, you usually produce as many as the number of people who will vote, even when electing a alumni association president, right? Whatever excuses there may be, this is an unacceptable situation." <<> Regarding the 2030 generation, who have been voicing criticism over this incident, President Lee said, "Young people, whom we had prejudged as very selfish and indifferent to justice, fairness, and order in the world, have instead raised issues in areas we deemed ourselves indifferent or less focused on." He added, "I thought, 'Ah, they are different from our generation,' and for that, I am very grateful." <<> However, he stated, "While we must protect the exercise of sovereign rights to secure legitimate voting rights, I have ordered strict investigations and accountability for acts such as publishing false information, spreading fake news, conducting illegal searches and seizures, and obstructing official duties." This was aimed at the recent rally at Seoul's Jamsil Olympic Park, sparked by the ballot paper shortage. President Lee also said, "We will respond strictly where necessary and ensure protection where it is clearly warranted." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대 브리핑에서 선관위를 향해 “저런 식으로 대법원장이 사실상 (선관위원장을) 임명하는 것처럼 해서 되겠느냐, 또 비상임으로 해서 선거 날에도 제대로 출근을 안 했다는 이야기가 있던데 그렇게 하면 되겠느냐”라며 “감시와 견제, 통제를 적정하게 해야 하지 않겠느냐. 이를 위한 법 제도 정비가 필요하겠다는 생각”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “필요하면 대통령이 직접 법안을 발의할 수도 있다”고 했다. 선관위가 헌법상 독립기관으로 돼 있기 때문에 개헌을 통해야만 선관위에 대한 견제와 통제, 감시를 강화할 수 있다는 취지다. 민주당도 같은 주장을 하고 있다. 하지만 국민의힘은 개헌은 추후 문제이고 당장 국정조사와 함께 특검을 해야 한다는 입장이다.)

item.title: Lee: "Trump said he's frustrated with US-North Korea dialogue... I advised a step-by-step approach." (李 “트럼프, 미북 대화 답답하다고 해… 단계적 접근 조언했다”)
item.description:
Lee: "Trump said he's frustrated with US-North Korea dialogue... I advised a step-by-step approach." (李 “트럼프, 미북 대화 답답하다고 해… 단계적 접근 조언했다”)

President Lee Jae-myung recently attended the G7 summit in Evian, France, where he encountered U.S. President Donald Trump several times and had a lengthy conversation at the dinner. A significant portion of their discussion reportedly focused on the North Korean nuclear issue. During a briefing upon returning from his overseas trip on the 19th, President Lee detailed the exchange that occurred. The remarks indicate that President Trump's focus has shifted from the Iran nuclear issue to North Korea's nuclear program. (이재명 대통령은 최근 프랑스 에비앙에서 열린 G7 정상회의에 참석해 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령을 여러 번 마주쳤고 만찬장에서는 긴 대화를 나눴다. 두 정상 대화의 상당 부분은 ‘북핵’ 문제에 집중됐다고 한다. 이 대통령은 19일 순방 귀국 브리핑에서 그때 오간 대화 내용을 구체적으로 밝혔다. 트럼프 대통령의 관심사가 이란 핵에 이어 북핵으로 넘어가고 있음을 보여주는 내용들이다.)

President Trump reportedly told President Lee, "It's time to pay attention to the North Korean issue." He then expressed frustration over ways to resume North Korea-U.S. talks and sought advice from President Lee. (트럼프 대통령은 이 대통령에게 “북한 문제에 대해서도 관심을 가져야 할 때가 됐다”고 했다고 한다. 그러면서 북미 대화 재개 방안에 답답함을 토로하며 이 대통령에게 조언을 구했다는 것이다.)

The two leaders, in particular, sat side by side at the official G7 dinner and conversed for 90 minutes. President Lee stated, "President Trump had the idea that he needed to talk to Kim Jong-un. But as for how to specifically resume dialogue, he seemed frustrated." President Trump also reportedly said, "It's regrettable that North Korea couldn't take feasible measures before realistically possessing nuclear weapons." (두 정상은 특히 G7 공식 만찬장에서 나란히 앉아 90분간 대화를 나눴다. 이 대통령은 “트럼프 대통령은 김정은과 대화해야 되겠다는 생각을 갖고 있었다”며 “그럼 어떻게 구체적으로, (대화를 재개할지) 이 점에 대해서는 답답해했다”고 전했다. 트럼프 대통령은 “북한도 핵무기를 현실적으로 보유하기 전 단계에서 뭔가 가능한 조치를 했어야 하는데 못 해서 아쉽다”는 말도 했다고 한다.)

In response, President Lee said, "'I told him, 'We shouldn't approach the North Korean nuclear issue the same way we deal with other countries,' and he agreed." When President Trump asked, "What exactly should be done?" President Lee replied, "The U.S. is seen as the only counterpart North Korea can talk to, and it would be good if the U.S. could offer a realistic proposal that North Korea can relate to." (이에 이 대통령은 “‘지금은 다른 나라를 대하는 방식으로 북핵 문제를 접근하면 안 된다’고 했고 (트럼프 대통령) 본인도 동의했다”고 전했다. 트럼프 대통령이 “구체적으로 어떻게 해야 되냐”고 묻자 이 대통령은 “미국과 북한이 대화할 수 있는 유일한 상대라고 보여지고, 미국이 좀 북한이 공감할 수 있는 현실적인 안을 좀 내면 좋겠다”고 했다.)

President Lee reportedly emphasized that the effectiveness of international sanctions has diminished due to the strengthened military cooperation between North Korea and Russia following the Russia-Ukraine war. When President Trump asked, "Would Russia really have provided that much help to North Korea while it's struggling?" President Lee responded, "North Korea's economy is this small, while Russia's economy is that large, so even a little help from Russia makes a big difference to North Korea. I heard North Korea's economic growth rate last year hit an all-time high." (이 대통령은 러시아·우크라이나 전쟁 이후 강력해진 북·러 군사 협력으로 국제 제재의 실효성이 떨어진 점을 강조했다고 한다. 트럼프 대통령이 ‘러시아도 어려운데 북한에 그렇게 많은 도움을 줬겠느냐’고 묻자, 이 대통령은 “북한 경제는 요만하고 러시아 경제는 이렇게 크기 때문에 러시아가 조금만 도와줘도 북한은 크게 도움이 된다. 작년에 북한의 경제성장률이 사상 최고였다고 한다”고 답했다는 것이다.)

President Lee also explained at length, "North Korea continues to produce nuclear materials, and its ICBM development appears to be in its final stages. Let's set a short-term goal of halting this, and create a situation where there is no longer a threat to the regime, making denuclearization a long-term goal." In response, President Trump reportedly said, "I'll give it enough thought." (이 대통령은 또 “북한은 핵물질을 계속 생산해 내고 있고 ICBM 대륙간탄도미사일도 마지막 개발 단계에 있는 것으로 보인다”며 “이를 중단시키는 것을 단기적인 목표로 일단 하고, 체제 위협이 더 없다고 판단되는 상황을 만들어 비핵화를 향해 가는 것을 장기 목표로 삼자”고 길게 설명했다고 전했다. 이에 트럼프 대통령은 “충분히 고민해보겠다”는 답을 했다고 한다.)

Regarding South Korea-U.S. shipbuilding cooperation, President Lee noted, "He (President Trump) mentioned it before, and this time he also asked me if we could quickly build 10 U.S. Navy ships. I replied that it's certainly possible and we'll do our best." President Lee mentioned French President Emmanuel Macron in relation to how he ended up sitting next to President Trump at the official G7 dinner, saying, "He told me that he deliberately seated me next to President Trump at the dinner." (한미 조선 협력과 관련해, 이 대통령은 “(트럼프 대통령이) 전에도 한 번 말씀하셨는데, 이번에도 역시 미국 군함 10척을 빠르게 건조해 줄 수 있냐는 의사를 제게 물어봤다”며 “거기에 대해서 당연히 가능하고 최선을 다하겠다고 답했다”고 전했다. 이 대통령은 G7 공식 만찬 때 트럼프 대통령 옆자리에 앉게 된 배경과 관련해 의장국 정상인 에마뉘엘 마크롱 프랑스 대통령을 언급하며 “일부러 만찬 자리에서 트럼프 대통령과 자리를 붙여줬다고 저한테 말씀하셨다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, President Lee stated that during his overseas trip, he asked Pope Leo XIV "to visit South Korea on the occasion of the World Youth Day held in Seoul next year, and requested that he use the visit as an opportunity to tour the DMZ and, if possible, promote a visit to North Korea." President Lee added, "The Pope said he would actively consider and work toward it." President Lee held a one-on-one meeting with Pope Leo XIV at the Vatican on the 15th (local time). (한편, 이 대통령은 순방 기간 중 레오 14세 교황에게 “내년 서울에서 개최되는 세계 청년대회를 계기로 방한을 요청했고, 방한을 계기로 DMZ 방문과 가급적이라면 북한 방문도 추진해 달라고 요청했다”고 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 “교황께서도 적극적으로 고려하고 추진해 보겠다는 말씀을 하셨다”고 전했다. 이 대통령은 지난 15일(현지 시각) 바티칸 교황청에서 레오 14세 교황과 단독 면담을 가졌다.)

President Lee asked Pope Leo XIV to appoint a current cardinal responsible for domestic affairs, and introduced, "Contrary to expectations, he hasn't appointed a single cardinal yet, but he said that if he were to newly appoint a cardinal in the future, he would give special consideration to Korea's circumstances." (이 대통령은 레오 14세 교황에게 국내 업무를 담당하는 현직 추기경을 임명해달라고 요청하면서 “예상과 달리 본인이 추기경을 임명한 사람이 아직 한 명도 없는데, 앞으로 만약에 새로 추기경을 임명하게 된다면 한국의 사정을 각별히 고려하겠다고 말했다”라고 소개했다.)

item.title: Chung Cheong-rae Silent on Lee’s Briefing, Visits Honam (李 브리핑에 침묵한 정청래, 호남 찾아가)
item.description:
Chung Cheong-rae Silent on Lee’s Briefing, Visits Honam (李 브리핑에 침묵한 정청래, 호남 찾아가)

When President Lee Jae-myung called a press conference on the 19th and appeared to target Chung Cheong-rae, the leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, with his remarks, pro-Lee factions said, "With the President going this far, can Representative Chung really dare to seek reelection as party leader?" However, Representative Chung is reportedly likely to resign as party leader next week and formalize his candidacy for the August party convention. (이재명 대통령이 19일 기자회견을 자청해 정청래 더불어민주당 대표를 겨냥한 듯한 발언을 쏟아내자, 친명계에선 “대통령이 이렇게까지 했는데 정 대표가 과연 당대표 연임 도전에 나설 수 있겠냐”는 말이 나왔다. 하지만 정 대표는 다음 주 당대표직을 사퇴하면서 8월 전당대회 출마를 공식화할 가능성이 큰 것으로 전해졌다.)

At the party meeting that morning, Representative Chung praised the President’s overseas trip for the third consecutive day, saying, "The President is world-class." Later, he visited the Democratic Party’s stronghold of North Jeolla Province, touring Jeonju, Gunsan, and Iksan. The itinerary was not publicized, but in the evening, Chung posted related photos on Facebook, writing, "I felt sorry, grateful, and appreciative upon hearing words like, 'You've worked hard as party leader. Hang in there.'" However, there was no mention of the President’s remarks that day. A Democratic Party official commented, "With the ruling camp divided over Representative Chung’s reelection as party leader, he must be deeply troubled." (정 대표는 이날 오전 당 회의에서 “대통령은 월드클래스”라며 사흘째 대통령 순방 성과를 치켜세웠다. 이후엔 민주당 텃밭인 전북을 찾아 전주, 군산, 익산을 돌았다. 이 일정은 비공개였는데, 정 대표는 이날 저녁 페이스북에 관련 사진을 올리며 “‘당대표가 참 고생이 많았제. 힘내시오’란 말씀을 들으면서 죄송하고 감사하고 고마웠다”고 썼다. 다만 이날 대통령 발언에 대한 언급은 없었다. 민주당 관계자는 “정 대표도 자신의 당대표 연임을 두고 여권이 분열하고 있는데 고민이 크지 않겠느냐”고 했다.)

Nevertheless, Chung is known to have decided to run. A Democratic Party figure close to Chung said, "The more the President acts like this, the more he has no choice but to run," adding, "While lawmakers try to dissuade him, party members' demands are only growing." Chung is also reported to have told those around him, "If I don’t run, it could spark controversy over interference in party affairs, harming the President." On the other hand, pro-Lee factions continued to pressure Chung not to run on that day as well. Lawmaker Chung Jin-wook stated, "The Democratic Party’s approval rating is falling because those who should take responsibility are not doing so." A key pro-Lee figure remarked, "Representative Chung, pretending not to hear the President’s message, held a campaign for reelection as party leader in Honam today." <<> When Representative Chung formalizes his bid for reelection as party leader, he is expected to continue sending messages to hardline supporters while emphasizing that he will be a party leader dedicated to the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration. A senior lawmaker said, "If Representative Chung, backed by hardline supporters, pushes ahead with his candidacy despite the President’s remarks, as the President said, it will be not a ‘competition’ but a ‘war.’" (하지만 정 대표는 출마 쪽으로 가닥을 잡은 것으로 알려졌다. 정 대표와 가까운 민주당 인사는 “대통령이 저럴수록 출마를 더 할 수밖에 없다”며 “의원들은 말려도 당원들의 요구는 더 커지는 상황”이라고 했다. 정 대표도 주변에 “내가 불출마하면 오히려 당무 개입 논란이 일어서 대통령에게 피해가 갈 수 있다”고 말한 것으로 알려졌다. 반면 친명계는 이날도 정 대표의 불출마를 압박했다. 정진욱 의원은 “민주당 지지율이 떨어지는 것은 책임질 사람이 책임지지 않고 있기 때문”이라고 했다. 친명계 핵심 인사는 “정 대표가 대통령 메시지를 모른 척하며 오늘도 호남에서 당대표 연임을 위한 선거운동을 벌였다”고 했다.)

item.title: Lee Expresses Discontent with Opposition: "Bragging About Stock Index at 9,000? Don't Make Up Stories" (李, 야당에 불만 표출 “주가 9000 자화자찬? 없는 얘기 하지 말라”)
item.description:
Lee Expresses Discontent with Opposition: "Bragging About Stock Index at 9,000? Don't Make Up Stories" (李, 야당에 불만 표출 “주가 9000 자화자찬? 없는 얘기 하지 말라”)

President Lee Jae-myung revealed his discomfort on the 19th, saying, "When did I ever brag about the stock index reaching 9,000?" This was interpreted as a response to the People Power Party's criticism, based on remarks from their floor leader, that "the government is intoxicated by the KOSPI at 9,000 and bragging about it." (이재명 대통령은 19일 “내가 언제 주가 9000을 가지고 자화자찬했느냐”며 불편한 심경을 드러냈다. 이날 국민의힘이 원내대표 발언 등을 통해 “정부가 코스피 9000에 도취해 자화자찬한다”고 비판한 것을 겨냥한 발언으로 해석됐다.)

During the Cheong Wa Dae briefing that day, President Lee stated, "I've been cautious about discussing stock prices and deliberately avoided doing so. I have never once mentioned it. (When did I) brag about it reaching a certain thousand points?" He added, "Even if you attack me, don't fabricate false claims," and "Why are your expressions so cheap, slandering with baseless facts?" This directly targeted a comment made that day by People Power Party floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik, who said in a party meeting, "The president and government, who bear infinite responsibility for state affairs, should not be intoxicated by the KOSPI at 9,000 and bragging." <<> President Lee remarked, "I have a concern. Polarization in the stock market leads to severe asset polarization." He continued, "It would be good if everything could grow together, but that's not easy. Still, just because someone bragged, can you make up stories that aren't true?" He then added, "Whether between the ruling and opposition parties or within a party, I hope political debates are competitions, not wars." <<> Addressing both sides, he said, "If you have rational debates based on facts, the public will think, 'Who's right?' or 'Who's cooler?'" He added, "When you resort to slander like this, don't emotions get hurt?" He also noted, "This isn't politics; it's a brawl. How uncomfortable must it be for the public to watch?" <<> Although President Lee said that day, "Did I brag about reaching a certain thousand points?" he has previously mentioned the KOSPI's rise on several occasions. In a June video on "Lee Jae-myung TV" titled "KOSPI at 8,000, Still Undervalued, Right?" President Lee remarked, "It has risen tremendously" and "It became like this in just six months." On the same day, Democratic Party leader Jung Cheong-rae also said in a party meeting regarding the KOSPI surpassing the 9,000 mark, "This is the result of the government's strong will to normalize the stock market." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대 브리핑에서 “주가 얘기는 조심스러워서 일부러 하지 않고 있었다. 일체 한 번도 언급한 일이 없다. (내가 언제) 몇 천 포인트 됐다고 막 자랑했나”라고 했다. 그러면서 “저를 공격하더라도 없는 얘기를 만들어서 하지 말라”며 “표현은 왜 그리 저렴하며 없는 사실로 음해를 하나”라고도 했다. 이날 국민의힘 정점식 원내대표가 당 회의에서 “국정에 무한한 책임을 진 대통령과 정부는 코스피 9000에 도취하고 자화자찬할 때가 아니다”라고 한 것을 직격한 것이다.)

item.title: Investigation recommends prosecution of 12, including Noh Tae-ak and Wi Cheol-hwan: "NEC needs near-dissolution-level reform" (노태악·위철환 등 12명 수사 권고 “선관위, 해체에 가까운 혁신 필요”)
item.description:
Investigation recommends prosecution of 12, including Noh Tae-ak and Wi Cheol-hwan: "NEC needs near-dissolution-level reform" (노태악·위철환 등 12명 수사 권고 “선관위, 해체에 가까운 혁신 필요”)

The Central Election Commission's (NEC) Fact-Finding Committee, which investigated the shortage of ballot papers during the June 3 local elections, recommended on the 19th that the NEC request an investigation into 12 individuals, including former NEC Chairman Noh Tae-ak and Acting Chairman Wi Cheol-hwan. The committee stated, "Given the overall inadequacy of the election management system, a sweeping reform approaching the dissolution of the NEC is necessary," and also proposed various measures. (6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태를 조사한 중앙선거관리위원회 진상규명위원회가 19일 노태악 전 중앙선관위원장과 위철환 위원장 직무대행 등 12명에 대해 중앙선관위에 수사 의뢰를 권고했다. 진상규명위는 “선거관리 시스템의 총체적 부실 상황을 볼 때 선관위 해체에 가까운 대대적 혁신이 필요하다”며 각종 대책도 냈다.)

Fact-Finding Committee Chairman Cho Hyun-wook announced this during a final briefing held at the NEC in Gwacheon, Gyeonggi Province. The 12 individuals recommended for investigation include former Chairman Noh, Acting Chairman Wi, and former NEC Secretary-General Heo Cheol-hoon (ministerial rank). The joint prosecution and police investigation team, currently operating under President Lee Jae-myung's directive, has already booked former Chairman Noh and former Secretary-General Heo as suspects and imposed a travel ban. The committee also recommended disciplinary action against six NEC staff members, including those from the Seoul Metropolitan and Songpa District Election Commissions. <<> According to the committee, on the day of the local elections, 140 out of 14,288 polling stations nationwide expected a shortage of ballot papers and received additional supplies. Among these, 91 polling stations actually used the additional ballots, and voting was temporarily halted at 26 stations. (조현욱 진상규명위원장은 이날 경기 과천 중앙선관위에서 활동 종료 보고 브리핑을 열고 이같이 밝혔다. 수사 의뢰 권고 대상은 노 전 위원장과 위 대행, 허철훈 전 중앙선관위 사무총장(장관급) 등 12명이다. 현재 이재명 대통령의 지시로 가동 중인 검·경 합동수사본부가 노 전 위원장과 허 전 사무총장 등을 피의자로 입건하고 출국금지 조치를 내린 상태다. 진상규명위는 중앙선관위와 서울시선관위, 송파구선관위 실무자 6명에 대해선 징계를 권고했다.)

As a preventive measure, the committee pointed out that the current part-time position of NEC Chairman should be converted to a full-time role. It also noted that, following last year's Constitutional Court decision, the NEC was excluded from the Board of Audit and Inspection's (BAI) scope of work audits, and stated, "There is a need to improve the system so that the NEC is included within the BAI's scope of work audits." The six-member committee, composed of external experts, concluded its activities today after a nine-day investigation that began on the 10th. (진상규명위에 따르면 지방선거 당일 투표용지 부족이 예상돼 추가 투표용지를 송부받은 투표소는 전국 1만4288개 투표소 중 140곳이다. 그중 추가 송부받은 투표용지를 실제 사용한 투표소는 91곳이며, 잠시라도 투표 중단이 발생한 투표소는 26곳이다.)

item.title: Approval Ratings Drop and Supplementary Investigation Powers Controversy... Lee Blames Party Leadership (지지율 하락도, 보완수사권 논란도… 李, 당 지도부 문제로 돌렸다)
item.description:
Approval Ratings Drop and Supplementary Investigation Powers Controversy... Lee Blames Party Leadership (지지율 하락도, 보완수사권 논란도… 李, 당 지도부 문제로 돌렸다)

President Lee Jae-myung on the 19th lashed out at the Democratic Party of Korea, stating, "Fighting is part of political culture, but what if you fight as if to kill, and actually kill? They're not even enemies," in a pointed remark. This was interpreted as the President, just a day after returning from an 8-night, 10-day European tour, personally taking the microphone to calm the factional conflict between the pro-Lee and pro-Chung camps within the Democratic Party over the upcoming party leadership race. However, within the ruling party, it was seen as "aimed at Representative Jeong Cheong-rae, who is preparing for a second term as party leader." (이재명 대통령은 19일 더불어민주당을 향해 “싸우는 것도 정치 문화의 일부이지만 진짜 죽일 듯이 싸우고, 진짜 죽이면 어떡하느냐. 적도 아니고”라며 작심 발언을 쏟아냈다. 대통령이 8박 10일간 유럽 순방을 다녀온 다음 날 직접 마이크를 잡고 차기 당권을 둘러싼 민주당 내 친명, 친청 갈등을 수습하려는 것으로 해석됐다. 그러나 여권에서는 “당대표 연임을 준비하는 정청래 대표를 겨냥한 것”이라는 해석이 나왔다.)

During a briefing at the Cheongwadae that day, President Lee said, "It may look like there's immense conflict between the Democratic Party and the government, but I see it as part of a process for achieving better results." While the President's remarks about the ruling party's internal power struggle began as a general explanation of the party-government relationship, by the end of the press conference, his tone grew harsher, using phrases like "as if fighting enemies" and "war." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대 브리핑에서 “민주당과 정부가 엄청난 갈등이 있는 것처럼 보이지만, 저는 더 잘되기 위한 과정이라고 생각한다”고 했다. 이날 대통령이 여당의 당권 싸움을 두고 한 발언은 처음엔 당청 간 원론적 관계를 설명하면서 시작했지만 기자회견 말미엔 “원수 싸우듯이” “전쟁” 등의 단어를 써가며 강한 어조로 바뀌었다.)

President Lee added, "We must engage in rational competition. Don't fabricate things that don't exist. Don't insult each other. There are those who hide. Those watching should find it interesting to see who wins." He then said, "It's annoying and disgusting to see them fight like that." He continued, "However big our internal differences are, are they as big as the differences with opponents we must defeat?" and concluded, "Once it's over, it's all done." (이 대통령은 “합리적 경쟁을 해야 한다. 없는 것을 지어내지 마시라”면서 “모욕하지 마시라. 숨어서 그런 사람들이 있다. 지켜보는 사람들이 ‘누가 이길까’ 하며 재미있게 결과를 지켜봐야 한다”고 했다. 그러면서 “보면 짜증나고 쳐다보기도 싫게 왜 그렇게 싸우나”라고 했다. 이어 “우리 안의 차이가 아무리 큰들 상대와 싸워 이겨야 할 상대와의 차이만큼 크겠나”라며 “지나면 다 그만”이라고 했다.)

Regarding the concurrent drop in approval ratings for both the President and the ruling party after the elections, President Lee stated, "State affairs haven't changed. Yet approval ratings have plummeted since election day." He added, "It must be that more people are dissatisfied with the President and the party." He specifically noted, "I think a political party should be more inclusive and open. It would be good if they could focus on taking care of people's livelihoods and the economy, and on making improvements." This remark was analyzed as being directed at Representative Jeong Cheong-rae's leadership, which has been seen as only appealing to hardline supporters. On the issue of the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers, President Lee expressed a different stance from Representative Jeong, who advocates for complete abolition, saying, "My view is that blocking even exceptional cases where there is no room for abuse could lead to problems later." He added, "It's a very sensitive and heavily contaminated topic. It's not without aspects of being used as a political slogan. We'll follow whatever the National Assembly decides; since you've given the authority, you'll also bear the responsibility." (이 대통령은 선거 후 동반 하락한 대통령과 여당 지지율에 대해서도 “국정은 변한 게 없다”며 “그런데 선거일을 기점으로 지지율이 폭락하고 있다”고 했다. 그러면서 “대통령이, 당이 마음에 안 든다는 사람이 늘어난 거 아니겠나”라고 했다. 특히 “정당이란 조금 더 포용적이고 개방적이어야 한다고 생각한다”며 “민생과 경제를 챙기고, 개선하는 데 집중할 수 있으면 좋겠다”고 말했다. 이 같은 대통령 발언은 강성 지지층만 쳐다보는 정청래 지도부를 염두에 둔 것이란 분석이 나왔다. 이 대통령은 이날 검찰의 보완 수사권 문제에 대해서도 “악용될 여지가 없는 예외적인 경우까지 다 봉쇄해 놓으면 나중에 문제가 생길 수 있겠다는 게 내 생각”이라며 완전 폐지를 주장하는 정 대표와 다른 입장을 밝혔다. 그러면서 “너무 예민하고 많이 오염된 주제”라며 “정치적 슬로건으로 활용되는 측면이 없지 않다. 국회가 하자는 대로 할 테니까 권한을 준 것이니 책임도 지겠지”라고도 했다.)

Within the pro-Lee camp, the President's remarks that day were seen as "revealing discomfort toward Representative Jeong" and "essentially a message not to seek re-election." On the bulletin board of pro-government YouTuber Kim Eo-joon's 'Ddanji Ilbo', posts appeared saying, "The President is saying to choose Kim Min-seok, not Jeong Cheong-rae, as the next Democratic Party leader." (친명계에선 이날 대통령 발언에 대해 “정 대표에 대한 불편한 심경을 드러낸 것”이라며 “사실상 연임 도전에 나서지 말라는 메시지 아니겠나”란 말이 나왔다. 친여 유튜버 김어준씨의 ‘딴지일보’ 게시판에도 “대통령이 ‘민주당 차기 대표로 정청래는 안 되고 김민석을 뽑으라’고 하는 것”이란 글이 이어졌다.)

Conflict within the ruling party has intensified since the June 3 local elections. Even as the Democratic Party enjoyed the President's approval ratings in the 60% range, its failure to regain the Seoul mayoral seat led to a split over the responsibility of Representative Jeong Cheong-rae's leadership. In particular, this coincided with the August 17 national convention to elect the next party leader, escalating the conflict between the pro-Lee and pro-Chung factions to a peak. In this context, President Lee's designation of a new Prime Minister candidate immediately after the elections sparked talk that he was essentially pushing Prime Minister Kim Min-seok as the next party leader. At his first anniversary press conference on the 8th, right after the elections, President Lee also criticized the Jeong leadership by saying, "It's simply incomprehensible" and "We lost places where we should have won." (여권 내 갈등은 6·3 지방선거 이후 고조되고 있다. 민주당이 60%대 대통령 지지율 속에서도 서울시장 탈환 등에 실패하자 정청래 지도부 책임론을 두고 둘로 갈라졌다. 특히 차기 당대표를 뽑는 8·17 전당대회와 맞물리면서 친명, 친청 간 갈등은 극에 달했다. 이런 상황에서 이 대통령이 선거가 끝나자마자 후임 국무총리 후보자를 지명하면서 사실상 김민석 국무총리를 차기 당대표로 미는 것이란 말이 돌았다. 이 대통령은 선거 직후 열린 지난 8일 취임 1주년 기자회견에서도 선거 결과에 대해 “도대체 납득이 안 된다” “이겨야 할 곳에서 졌다” 등의 말을 하며 정청래 지도부를 비판했다.)

Controversy also arose when President Lee instructed Representative Jeong not to attend the departure ceremony for his European tour on the 9th, allowing only Prime Minister Kim to participate. Within the pro-Lee camp, this was interpreted as "the President backing Prime Minister Kim." Shortly after, the pro-Lee camp openly demanded that Representative Jeong resign as party leader and not run in the convention. (이 대통령이 지난 9일 유럽 순방 출국 행사에 정 대표는 오지 말라고 지시하고 김 총리만 참석시킨 것을 두고도 논란이 일었다. 친명계에선 “대통령이 김 총리에게 힘을 실은 것”이라는 해석이 나왔다. 이 직후부터 친명계는 노골적으로 정 대표에게 당대표직 사퇴와 전당대회 불출마를 요구했다.)

However, Representative Jeong also publicly stated, "Governments are fleeting, but the people are eternal," intensifying the clash between the pro-Lee and pro-Chung factions. On the 18th, at the President's return ceremony from the tour, Representative Jeong bowed 90 degrees to the President and remarked, "Life is about swaying and moving forward, isn't it?" As the Lee Jae-myung administration entered its second year, the worsening party-government conflict led to a decline in approval ratings for both the President and the ruling party. The ruling party's support base also split into the 'New Lee Jae-myung' mainstream and traditional supporters like the pro-Roh and pro-Moon factions. (하지만 정 대표도 “정권은 짧고 국민은 영원하다”는 발언을 공개적으로 하며 친명, 친청은 더 강하게 충돌했다. 정 대표는 지난 18일 대통령 순방 귀국 행사에서는 대통령에게 90도로 인사한 뒤 “흔들리며 가는 게 인생 아니겠냐”는 말도 했다. 이재명 정부가 출범 2년 차로 접어드는 시점에 당청 갈등이 심해지자 대통령과 여당 지지율이 하락했다. 여권 지지층도 ‘뉴이재명’ 신주류와 친노·친문 등 전통 지지층으로 쪼개져 분열했다.)

When asked why he did not invite Representative Jeong to the departure event for the tour, President Lee simply replied, "Having many people line up to see you off or welcome you back when going abroad or returning is not exactly a pleasant thing." (이 대통령은 이날 이번 순방 출국길에 정 대표를 부르지 않은 이유에 대해 “해외 출국하거나 귀국할 때 막 많은 사람이 줄 서서 하는 게 그렇게 뭐 흔쾌히 기분 좋은 일은 아니다”라고만 답했다.)

item.title: Ha Jung-woo, Defeated in Election, Eyed for Presidential AI Committee?… Opposition Calls It "Revolving Door Appointment" (선거 떨어진 하정우, 대통령직속 AI委로?… 野 “돌려막기 인사”)
item.description:
Ha Jung-woo, Defeated in Election, Eyed for Presidential AI Committee?… Opposition Calls It "Revolving Door Appointment" (선거 떨어진 하정우, 대통령직속 AI委로?… 野 “돌려막기 인사”)

It was reported on the 19th that President Lee Jae-myung is actively considering Ha Jung-woo, former senior presidential secretary for AI and future strategy at the Blue House, who ran as the Democratic Party candidate in the June 3 by-election for Busan's Northern Gap district and lost, for the full-time vice chairmanship of the National AI Strategy Committee, a body under the direct control of the president. The People Power Party criticized this as "the Lee Jae-myung administration's revolving door appointment" and demanded an immediate withdrawal. (이재명 대통령이 민주당 후보로 6.3 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마했다가 떨어진 하정우 전 청와대 AI미래기획수석을 대통령 직속 국가AI전략위원회 상근 부위원장에 유력 검토하는 것으로 19일 알려졌다. 국민의힘은 “이재명 정권의 ‘돌려막기식 회전문 인사’”라며 “당장 철회해야 한다”고 했다.)

Former senior secretary Ha stepped down from his post in April to run in this by-election. Having entered the Blue House from Naver, he resigned just about 10 months later to seek a seat in the National Assembly. However, if this appointment goes through, he would return as a "presidential aide" just over two weeks after losing the election. (하 전 수석은 이번 보궐선거 출마를 위해 지난 4월 수석직을 내려놨다. 네이버 출신인 그가 청와대에 들어온지 10개월여만에 국회 입성을 위해 사표를 낸 것이었다. 하지만 이번에 인사가 나면 낙선한 지 불과 보름여만에 다시 ‘대통령의 참모’로 복귀하게 된다.)

Notably, the full-time vice chairmanship of the Presidential National AI Strategy Committee, for which Ha’s name is being floated, was held until recently by Rep. Im Moon-young of the Democratic Party, who won the by-election in Gwangju's Gwangsan-eul district. Even within the Democratic Party, there are murmurs: "Are we so short on AI experts that we have to recycle them?" (특히 하 수석 이름이 거론되는 대통령 직속 국가AI전략위원회 상근 부위원장직은 이번 광주 광산을 보궐선거에 나가 당선된 임문영 민주당 의원이 직전까지 맡았던 자리다. 민주당에서도 “AI 관련한 전문가가 얼마나 부족하면 돌려 쓰겠냐”는 말이 나온다.)

President Lee has frequently demonstrated a personnel management style of reusing former appointees in different roles. Most recently, he nominated Minister of SMEs and Startups Han Sung-sook as the next prime minister. In the recent by-elections, a considerable number of former Blue House officials ran as candidates. Former Digital Communication Secretary Kim Nam-guk, former spokespersons Kim Nam-joon and Jeon Eun-soo were elected and entered the National Assembly, while former Senior Political Affairs Secretary Woo Sang-ho won the Gangwon Province governorship, and former National Unity Secretary Office administrator Son Hwa-jung was elected as mayor of Yeongjong-gu, Incheon. A ruling party insider remarked, "For former senior secretary Ha, who ran under the 'Lee Myung-pick' label, returning immediately after losing looks bad. In the long run, it could also burden the Blue House." (이 대통령은 한번 기용했던 사람을 자리만 바꿔 다시 쓰는 용인술을 자주 보이고 있다. 최근엔 한성숙 중소벤처기업부 장관을 후임 국무총리 후보자로 내정했다. 특히 이번 선거에는 청와대 출신 상당수가 출마하기도 했다. 김남국 전 디지털소통비서관, 김남준·전은수 전 대변인 등은 보궐선거에 나가 당선돼 여의도 입성에 성공했고, 우상호 전 정무수석은 강원지사에, 손화정 전 국민통합비서관실 행정관은 인천 영종구청장에 각각 당선됐다. 한 여권 관계자는 “명픽으로 출마한 하 전 수석의 경우 낙선 후 바로 복귀는 모양새가 좋지 않다”며 “길게 보면 청와대에도 부담이 될 것”이라고 했다.)

People Power Party Senior Spokesperson Choi Bo-yoon issued a statement on the same day, criticizing, "The president's stubbornness in pushing through an opportunistic appointment that even within the ruling party draws head-shaking only confirms how severely the talent pool of this administration has been depleted." (최보윤 국민의힘 수석대변인은 이날 논평을 내고 “여당 안에서조차 고개를 가로젓는 기회주의적 인사를 밀어붙이려는 대통령의 고집은 이 정권의 인재풀이 얼마나 처참하게 고갈됐는지를 스스로 방증할 뿐”이라고 비판했다.)

item.title: Lee tells opposition: "Don't fight like enemies" (李, 與 겨냥 “원수 싸우듯 하지 마라”)
item.description:
Lee tells opposition: "Don't fight like enemies" (李, 與 겨냥 “원수 싸우듯 하지 마라”)

President Lee Jae-myung said on the 19th, addressing the Democratic Party of Korea, "Don't fight like enemies," and added, "How can people within the same camp fence compete not in a rivalry but in a war?" While this remark was made with the overheated race for party leadership ahead of the August party convention in mind, pro-Lee factions interpreted it as "a message directed at Representative Jeong Cheong-rae, who is widely expected to challenge for a second term as party leader." <<> During a briefing on the outcomes of his European tour at the Cheong Wa Dae Chancery on the same day, President Lee faced a question about party- presidential office conflicts and said, "I really want to say a word about the competition and conflict within the Democratic Party." He added, "Insulting, slandering, making up false facts to attack, then claiming unfairness—why do that? What if you fight as if to kill and actually kill someone?" <<> Regarding the declining approval ratings for both the president and the ruling party after the local elections, President Lee directly targeted party leadership, including Representative Jeong, who had declared a 'victory' in these elections, saying, "Approval ratings have been plunging since election day." He stated, "The public has every right to be angry. They're struggling to make a living, and they wonder what all the fighting is about." <<> Following the president's remarks, pro-government communities saw posts like, "Isn't this ultimately telling Representative Jeong to give up his bid for party re-election?" There was also a flood of comments saying, "The president is craftily intervening in party affairs to push for Prime Minister Kim Min-seok as the next party leader." The ruling camp's support base appeared to deepen divisions, with pro-Lee and pro-Jeong supporters exchanging harsh words against each other. <<> Although the president's briefing that day was intended to personally explain the outcomes of his European tour, including attendance at the G7 summit, there were also interpretations that he directly stepped in with the internal party situation in mind. A ruling party official remarked, "He already held a nearly three-hour press conference on the 8th, right after the local elections, for his first anniversary in office. It's unusual for the president to personally hold another two-hour press conference the day after returning from a tour." (이재명 대통령은 19일 더불어민주당을 향해 “원수 싸우듯이 하지 마라”며 “같은 진영 울타리 안에 있는 사람들끼리 경쟁이 아니라 전쟁을 해서야 되겠느냐”고 말했다. 8월 전당대회를 앞두고 과열되고 있는 당권 경쟁을 염두에 둔 발언이었지만, 친명계에선 “당대표 연임 도전이 확실시되는 정청래 대표를 향한 메시지”라는 해석이 나왔다.)

]]>
